name: git-commit
description: Commit changes with a conventional commit message and push to remote
instructions: Stage all relevant changes with `git add`
Write a conventional commit message in the format `type(scope): description`
Valid types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, style, chore, test
Keep the commit message concise (under 72 characters) but descriptive
Push to the remote repository with `git push`
If the push fails due to remote changes, pull with rebase first (`git pull --rebase`)
Do NOT commit secrets, API keys, or large binary files
